data.one_liner: Flutter widget for animated icon transitions with gradients and opacity
data.what_it_does: AdvancedIcon provides a single widget that can display an icon with optional gradient or opacity and transition to a secondary icon using various animation effects. It exposes properties for color, gradient, opacity, effect, duration and state management hooks.
use_when: You need a simple icon that changes with a smooth animation when a state changes
You want to apply gradient or opacity to an icon without custom painting
You want to expose a secondary icon for user interaction
avoid_when: You need complex state management beyond simple setState or provider
You require icon animations that are not covered by the built‑in effects
strengths: Built‑in animation effects (spin, bubble, fade, flip, etc.)
Supports gradient and opacity directly on icons
Easy to use API, no code generation required
weaknesses: Limited to icon widgets, no support for custom shapes
No documentation on performance impact for many icons
No built‑in state management integration beyond basic patterns
data.minimal_example:
import 'package:advanced_icon/advanced_icon.dart';

AdvancedIcon(
  icon: Icons.add,
  secondaryIcon: Icons.check,
  state: _state,
  effect: AdvancedIconEffect.spin,
  duration: Duration(milliseconds: 700),
  color: Colors.blue,
  secondaryColor: Colors.green,
  opacity: 0.8,
  gradient: const LinearGradient(colors: [Colors.red, Colors.white]),
)
